**Ruled: the two landing endpoints are allow-listed by name.** Measured in this act: the objectstack spellings already exist since PR #19047 (`Bash(curl -sS -X POST https://api.github.com/repos/objectstack-ai/objectstack/pulls/*/ccr/ready_for_review *)`, `Bash(curl -sS -X PUT https://api.github.com/repos/objectstack-ai/objectstack/pulls/*/ccr/auto_merge *)`); the three PRs this card measured (objectui#10077, #10081, #10079) are **objectui** PRs, and no objectui spelling exists — that is the whole gap. B (seats never land) and C (a second landing identity) are ⛔ not taken. Nothing about approvals changes: an APPROVED review stays forbidden for every seat account, governed surfaces stay the maintainer's, the queue still runs every gate.

**Execution:** the two objectui rules ride PR-in-flight for #19469 (same file, same round; the director instructs that dev in this stroke). This card closes `completed` now — its decision is made and its remaining act lives on #19469; reopen is free if the merged rules do not clear the denial. Not part of this ruling, named for the objectui seat: the objectui half-state patrol anchor variable (`HALF_STATE_ANCHOR_ISSUE`) is unset — a repository-settings act, that lane's to raise. `needs-user-decision` removed in the same stroke as the close.
